name: Westrock Coffee - Conway AR Distribution Center

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed as 1430 William J. Clark Drive. Street View (2024-07) from William J. Clark Dr looking NE shows '1430' clearly on the building's office-entry facade. This is the Westrock Coffee DC: $70M, 530,000 sq ft, ~30-acre site, 36-ft clear, ~72 dock doors, ESFR, developed by Tempus Realty Partners, completed late 2023.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Chain-link perimeter fencing runs across the property frontage along William J. Clark Drive (visible in 2024-07 Street View and z19/z20 satellite). A truck driveway enters at the SW with a gate in the fence line; the truck yard is fully enclosed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth identified at the gate. The SW truck entrance reads as a gate in the perimeter fence with no adjacent booth — implying kiosk/remote check-in. Small structures near the building are utility/electrical, not a gatehouse. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Truck gate present, no guard shack seen — remote check-in inferred.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Published spec is ~72 dock doors. Satellite confirms long banks of dock doors with trailers backed in along the building's west face and additional doors on the north/south ends — banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Marked trailer-parking stalls and drop lanes line the west yard with ~30-55 trailers present (dropArea banded 25-50); a dedicated drop lot is present.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 25-50 trailers parked in marked stalls/lanes in the west yard.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved perimeter aprons and a deep yard give room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep gate-to-dock approach down the west yard easily stacks 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard between the gate and the dock faces serves as inside-the-fence staging.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located in the Conway industrial corridor near I-40 with surrounding commercial/industrial development — Urban.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Single large DC dock operation; no clearly separate ship vs. receive dock clusters — false.
